svg.text: MEKTRA / ALL WORLDS IN LEVEL ORDER

g.text: Read the next landing. Launch across the gap.
Wide targets are safer. Small targets carry bonus stars.
Lead the moving target before you launch.
Orange rings count down. Leave before the platform crumbles.
Watch the orange gate. Commit when it clears your path.
Room to breathe. Collect stars and find your next opening.
Read the moving gate, then leave the crumbling landing.
Thread the curved passage. Alternate sides to avoid the spikes.
Read the hexagon faces. Tight gaps reward a precise launch.
Capsule rain / diagonal rows / independent speeds / continuous right-to-left loop
Stay outside the purple pull ring. The vortex pulls you in and bursts.
Follow the lobes across horizontal and diagonal crossings.
Take the long leap, collect the trail, then rest on the wide landing.
Four later-world concepts: travel upward through the hollow middle, jumping between shapes.
Editable walls, platforms and stars. Concepts for review; not yet part of the running game.
Black honeycomb clusters, clear travel gaps, and stars between receiving shapes. Editable concepts.
Circles, connected lobes and diagonal crossings
